mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% AND INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.5% and INDPRO > 115.0), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are negative due to overbought market conditions and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% AND INDPRO > 115.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is negative, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it indicates a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1200.0) signals a weak economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0 AND HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 205.0), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are negative due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 205.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
